probes.name: bind_start
probes.description: Initial idle/stance entry frame; verifies zero root offset and stable bind alignment.

probes.name: root_flip_regression_guard
probes.description: Historical failure frame where collinear 2-point root fitting caused a 180-deg root flip; verifies multi-anchor IRLS Kabsch stability.

probes.name: stance_transition
probes.description: Mid-phase torso & upper limb transition; checks spine and upper-limb coordination.

probes.name: prayer_convergence
probes.description: Bilateral forearm/hand convergence in front of chest; exercises self-occlusion & forearm child-head pivot fusion.

probes.name: extension_release
probes.description: Wide lateral limb extension and flex-chain wave propagation.

probes.name: cycle_closure
probes.description: Final frame of the 12s (288-frame) 24fps exam clip; verifies zero cumulative drift.
